title: Pan-Seared Pork Tenderloin with Tart Cherry Glaze
description: A sweet and savory dish where tender pork tenderloin is pan-seared to perfection and topped with a rich tart cherry glaze.
instructions: Season the pork tenderloin with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork tenderloin until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook for 12-15 minutes, or until the pork reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
While the pork cooks, prepare the tart cherry glaze by combining the tart cherries, brown sugar, Dijon mustard, and heavy cream in a small saucepan.
Bring the glaze to a simmer over medium heat and cook until thickened, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the pork from the oven and brush the tart cherry glaze over the top.
Return the pork to the oven and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the glaze is caramelized.
Remove the pork from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve the pork tenderloin with additional tart cherry glaze spooned over the top, if desired.
